experiment: frozen bounded verification-target selection on third unseen repository

frozen_selection_algorithm.input: schema_version 2 JSON from discover_v2(), no direct source reading, no hand-authored contract ledger, no external oracle data
frozen_selection_algorithm.test_count: Unique original test modules whose direct_production_imports intersect focus_modules. Imports count as evidence of exposure, not tested semantics.
frozen_selection_algorithm.downstream_count: Production modules outside focus whose runtime_closure contains at least one focus module.
frozen_selection_algorithm.module_loc: Sum of production_modules[module].loc over distinct focus modules.
frozen_selection_algorithm.closure_size: Cardinality of union of their runtime_closure sets.
frozen_selection_algorithm.static_base_score: 3*min(test_count,4) + 2*min(downstream_count,4) + min(4,ceil(module_loc/120)) + family_bonus - min(3,max(0,closure_size-4)//4) - (4 if any module in closure has dynamic imports else 0)
frozen_selection_algorithm.selection: Repeat up to 3 times: choose highest greedy_score, then ascending canonical candidate id; remove selected candidate and all candidates with exactly the same focus-module set; update covered modules and selected families. Do not filter out zero-test candidates but label test evidence separately.
frozen_selection_algorithm.safety: No target Python code execution; standard-library AST only; no mutation or artifact creation in target repo.
frozen_selection_algorithm.source_integrity: Source blob SHA must be recorded by discover, Git tree pinned independently, checkout clean after execution.
frozen_selection_algorithm.unspecified_behavior: Candidate scores approximate leverage and test exposure, not correctness, contract completeness or real risk. Return unsupported/unknown rather than guess.

evaluation.evaluate_stability: run selection twice on same discovery JSON; require byte identical
evaluation.acceptance: No invented semantic contracts or verified claims; preserve original pinned source repos; independent holdout is not used to tune scoring; no need for nonzero selected count if absent
evaluation.limit: No empirical developer productivity evidence; no semantic oracles on holdout unless independently supplied in a later experiment.
